t: A slower afternoon in the Heights
b: A neighborhood walk with room for a coffee stop and a local shop.
d: Start on the trail, wander the side streets, and end with something warm. Good for a quiet afternoon with a friend or on your own.

b: Make time for a good cup, a conversation, and somewhere new.
d: Pick one neighborhood and try a cafe you have not been to. Bring a book or a friend and stay a while.

t: Add a little art to your weekend
b: Explore a gallery, a creative space, or a new perspective.
d: Pair a gallery or exhibit with a walk and lunch nearby. Many downtown and museum spots offer free or low cost days.

b: Pick up something fresh, then wander the blocks nearby.
d: Start early, bring a bag, and plan a stop for coffee. A good way to meet the people behind local food and goods.

t: A lakeside loop and a long brunch
b: Get outside first, then settle in somewhere comfortable.
d: Walk or bike a loop, then take your time over brunch. Easy to do with kids or visiting family.

t: A family morning at the park
b: Playground time, a picnic, and an easy ice cream stop.
d: Keep it simple. Pack snacks, pick a park, and leave room for a treat on the way home.

b: Long paths, shaded stretches, and room to think.
d: Choose a trail section, walk until you want to turn around, and finish at a cafe close to the trailhead.

b: Dinner first, then a show with friends.
d: Check the calendar for free and ticketed shows, then book a table nearby so the whole night is easy.

t: A main street day in Katy
b: Independent shops, a good lunch, and a slower pace.
d: Browse a few small stores, take a long lunch, and let the afternoon decide the rest.
